flows.destination: Configured AI provider endpoints (OpenAI/Anthropic/etc via Main secret broker)
flows.minimization: Secrets redacted by transcript/SEKB policies before durable stores; raw provider traffic uses Main-owned keys
flows.userControl: Provider keys in Settings > AI Providers; session delete cascade
flows.retention: Provider-side per vendor policy; local transcripts subject to session hard-delete cascade

flows.destination: Provider OAuth token endpoints and local OS keychain/secret store
flows.minimization: Tokens stored via secret store; never rendered in ErrorBoundary or host-api responses
flows.userControl: Disconnect provider / clear credentials in Settings
flows.retention: Until user revocation or secret-store delete

flows.destination: Configured MCP server processes / remote MCP endpoints
flows.minimization: Host-api boundary + path broker; SEKB redaction on durable trajectory capture
flows.userControl: MCP enablement and server allowlist in Settings

flows.source: Auto-update feed checks and download integrity
flows.destination: Pinned update feed hosts + local download cache
flows.minimization: No chat content; feed must pass integrity/provenance gates
flows.retention: Installer artifacts until replaced; feed metadata ephemeral

flows.source: Clipboard write, agent-browser/remote-control screenshots, desktop automation
flows.destination: Local OS clipboard / local screenshot artifacts under userData (session-scoped)
flows.minimization: Sensitive capture policy kill switch + per-channel enable/grant + retention max hours
flows.retention: Bounded by retentionMaxHours; session cascade for browser artifacts

flows.destination: Local in-memory history + optional install/report when telemetryEnabled
flows.minimization: Local-only by default; telemetryEnabled setting; no secret fields in trackUiEvent contract
flows.retention: In-memory ring (500 entries) until process exit
